description: NYC fire-sprinkler and standpipe specialist in Long Island City, also handling alarms, extinguishers and kitchen suppression to NFPA and local code across the five boroughs, Westchester and Long Island. Bulk-imported 9/10/26; no contact, outreach or financials on record.

Brooklyn UL-certified, family-owned integrator founded 1980, combining burglar and fire alarms, camera surveillance, access control and structured wiring. Bulk-imported 9/10/26; no contact, outreach or financials on record.

Locksmith and door company founded 1962 (~35 employees) - mechanical hardware, access control, video, safes and a full door division; factory-authorized for Horton, Besam, Dor-O-Matic and Stanley, with a retail showroom and tri-state service fleet. Affiliated entity L.I. Automatic Doors, Inc. operates from the same Hicksville base; confirm whether both are in scope.

Great Neck locksmith specializing in window guards and gates, plus lock, door and security installation and repair including interior and automatic doors. Serves commercial and residential clients across NY Metro and Long Island. Bulk-imported 9/10/26; no contact, outreach or financials on record.

Hollow metal doors, frames and locking hardware plus intercom - sales, service and installation. Founded 1994, warehouse and door shop at 15 Daniel Rd, Fairfield NJ. 9 employees (3 technical), 2 service vehicles. ~90% multifamily/property-management customers across NYC and NJ; ~80% repeat business but no contractual recurring revenue. Off-market intro via Paul Cernak (Cosmic Fischer). Three partners: Joe (~60, our contact, met in NJ week of 9/14), Leon Leshchinsky (mid-70s, runs the business and is exiting year-end 2026; holds wages at $15–16/hr, so labor is subcontracted out of necessity, not by design), and Serge Edelman (~86, largely out of the business). FY2025 revenue $1,866,796 and operating income $488,881 per QuickBooks P&L (unadjusted - no add-backs, no D&A line, no owner-comp normalization). Revenue declining 2023-2025; two customers are ~38% of four-year revenue. Related entities Reliable Lock & Safe and SL Communications have separate P&Ls on file. No NDA signed.
Low-voltage integrator founded 2015 installing IP cameras, access control, intercoms, burglar alarms, VoIP and structured cabling across Brooklyn, Queens and Manhattan.

Licensed and bonded locksmith founded 2013 in Fresh Meadows, Queens, serving NYC metro, Long Island, Westchester and NJ. 24/7 residential, commercial and automotive lock, access-control and intercom work. President is Shlomi Sorin. Outreach opened 9/10/26; no financials provided to date.
Third-generation Upper East Side locksmith operating since 1952 with an in-house manufacturing and welding shop, specializing in revolving, fire-rated and automatic doors.

Brooklyn-based low-voltage security integrator founded 2007 (NYC alarm-installer licensed 2013), covering all five boroughs plus NJ. Access control, cameras/NVR and IT/networking; no residential work in roughly ten years.

Multi-entity group: Precision Lock & Safe (Floral Park showroom), Walbaum Locksmith, Steven Building Supply, plus a separate forensics and expert-witness entity. Medeco/ASSA ABLOY partner; owner is a media-featured safecracker (CBS, NYT, AP). Serves Long Island, the five boroughs and Westchester.

Whitestone fire alarm. 636 NYC commercial contracts, sub-2% attrition, 99% auto-renew. $2.65M rev / $642K EBITDA vs broker's $1.34M 'synergized'. Mix 30% monitoring / 38% T&I / 32% repair. KILL: Bisnoff (85%) holds the NYS S-97 license personally and is exiting - no other principal. Revenue flat 4 yrs, zero sales function in the retained 8. $154K MRR doesn't tie to a 30% monitoring mix. Website license #12000020098 does not match CIM's #12000328603. Anchor $3-4M. Broker: Connor Slivocka, Flatirons.

Second-generation family business providing structured cabling, CCTV, access control, VoIP and intercom systems to commercial and multifamily clients. Legal entity is Eastern American Data/Voice, Inc. dba Eastern American Technologies.
Operating since 1996 from Greenwich Village, serves NYC's five boroughs and NJ with locksmithing, access control and surveillance for property managers, offices and residential buildings.
